mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where the CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 2 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the previous 3 months signals increased supply-side capacity, which supports economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where INDPRO increases over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% over the previous quarter, it signals a monetary tightening cycle with weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3%, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% over the previous 3 months signals a robust economy with strong supply and labor markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where INDPRO increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2%.
